latin: Phantasma est agens secundarium et instrumentale in productione speciei intelligibilis.

mentions.context: light bodies are moved in themselves, but not by themselves.183 One notes that Pico is more cautious than Thomas in this case, preferring degrees of probabil- ity (potius … quam) over a full commitment to determine this issue. In thesis 39 we find that phantasm (phantasma) is a secondary and instru- mental actor in the production of intelligible species.184 The philosophical motivation of Pico here is obviously to increase the independence of the

quam, quia a generante habent, dicuntur a generante moveri per se, secundum philoso- phum in viii phys., sed a removente prohibens per accidens: et haec moventur seipsis, sed non a seipsis.” And compare n. 178 and context. 184 Pico, 900 Theses, p. 230: “Phantasma est agens secundarium et instrumentale in produc- tione speciei intelligibilis.” ## Page 275
